title: Canonical fixed-compactification projection comparison equation
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$ of its valuation ring, and $n\geq1$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a compactification $c=(j,p_f)$, $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p_f}Y$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements].
Use ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $V_T=\nu_T^*$ for exact derived comparison [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback], $F_f=Rp_{f,\mathrm{et},*}j^{\mathrm{et}}_!$ for ordinary etale compact support [def-amb-etale-compact-support], and $P_f=Rp_{f,\mathrm{proet},*}j^{\mathrm{proet}}_!$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. For a bounded-below etale complex $B$, let
$$C_B:P_fV_XB\xrightarrow{\sim}V_YF_fB$$
be the canonical comparison of [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison]. Let $M\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $H\in D^b_c(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], and assume $H$ has finite Tor amplitude [def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Use ordinary derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor] and the corresponding pro-etale tensor [def-weil-derived-tensor]. Let $\operatorname{PF}^{e}_{M,H}:F_fM\otimes_A^LH\to F_f(M\otimes_A^Lf^*H)$ be the compactification composite of the proper counit-defined projection map [def-kun-projection-formula-map] and the canonical ordinary etale open-extension tensor comparison [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor], and let $\operatorname{PF}^{p}$ be the pro-etale compactification projection map of [def-exchange-projection].
Define the tensor target D=M\otimes_A^Lf^*H. Given witnesses M,D\in D^+, define ProjectionComparisonEquation to mean exactly the displayed equality of derived morphisms
$$C_D\circ P_f(\tau_{M,H})\circ\operatorname{PF}^p_{V_XM,V_YH}=V_Y(\operatorname{PF}^e_{M,H})\circ t_{F_fM,H}\circ(C_M\otimes1),$$
where \tau is the canonical target identification obtained from the pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback] and the tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. The open part of C is the canonical exact site comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. Define projectionComparisonConclusion to be the existence of those two bounded-below witnesses together with this equation, for the fixed finite-field/coefficient data and bounded-constructible finite-Tor inputs above. These are definitions of the equation and conclusion, with no assertion that they hold.
